item.title: Rip Off font Chiavari by Anagrama
item.description:
Hi,

I designed the typeface Chiavari in 2009 and won a TDC award in 2012
http://tdc.org/competitionwriteup/tdc-typeface-design-winners-2012/
https://www.behance.net/gallery/2657771/YARD-RISK-AND-BUSINESS

A few days ago, I stumbled upon the rip off version of my font by the studio Anagrama
http://www.anagrama.com/portafolio/167-naci%C3%B3n

Any thoughts on how to react to this and what I can realistically do would be much appreciated.
Thank you.

H.

item.title: Rip-off of one our font (Oblik Bold)
item.description:
We found an rip-off of our “Oblik” in Bold weight.

At first it was disturbing to find out something like this, but then I’m now feeling a little empathy for this guy, for the reason he is young (judging by his photo and by his profile description). But this is not the way to build your design career or to go in public without having any responsibility for your acts.
